review_observations: Native PostgreSQL catalog access-method classes are core provider metadata; no deletion based on index use statistics.
Cross-type date/timestamp/timestamptz operators are intentional distinct type signatures; support functions include shared timestamp_hash and cross-cast comparison.
Text_pattern and varchar_pattern collation-ordering strategies differ from locale-aware comparison, and their presence is not duplicate dead code.
Geometric GiST/SP-GiST and text-search GIN/GiST operators have search and/or order by purpose; strategy differences do not prove an error.
System OID, record, transaction ID, LSN, UUID, time-series and FTS families have catalog-backed native handlers; runtime query/planner behavior remains unverified.

source_queries.class: WITH ordered AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY n.nspname,c.opcname,c.oid) AS ordinal,c.oid::text AS oid,n.nspname AS schema,c.opcname AS name,am.amname AS access_method,format_type(c.opcintype,NULL) AS input_type,format_type(c.opckeytype,NULL) AS key_type,c.opcdefault AS is_default,c.opcfamily::text AS family_oid,fn.nspname AS family_schema,ff.opfname AS family_name,pg_get_userbyid(c.opcowner) AS owner,obj_description(c.oid,'pg_opclass') AS comment,(SELECT e.extname FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.classid='pg_opclass'::regclass AND d.objid=c.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' LIMIT 1) AS extension_dependency,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index i WHERE c.oid = ANY(i.indclass)) AS indexes_using FROM pg_opclass c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.opcnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid=c.opcmethod JOIN pg_opfamily ff ON ff.oid=c.opcfamily JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=ff.opfnamespace) SELECT * FROM ordered ORDER BY ordinal
